name: Zettai Kangoku
source:
Spy soldier "Grave" investigates the facility of a female prison where human experiments are being performed.
With extensive cosmetic surgery and a disguise, Grave becomes a warden of the prison.
Inside he discovers countless young girls being sexually abused by another warden named Eliza.
Among the prisoners is Anna, Grave's wife, who doesn't realize who's here to save her.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103040.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
间谍士兵“墓碑”调查一座正在进行人体实验的女子监狱设施。
通过大量的整容手术和伪装，墓碑成为了监狱的看守。
在监狱里，他发现无数年轻女孩正遭受另一位名叫艾丽莎的看守的性虐待。
囚犯中包括墓碑的妻子安娜，她没有意识到前来拯救她的人是谁。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103040.html]DLSite English[/url]]
